LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Linked: {TENDER} has linked {PAWN_nameDef} into {FACTION}. {PAWN_pronoun} can command {COUNT} more bandwidth of mechs while the Lattice and the colony are at peace, and may now and then dream another linked mind's dream.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_LinkedWork: {TENDER} has linked {PAWN_nameDef} into {FACTION} for work only. {PAWN_pronoun} can command {COUNT} more bandwidth of mechs while the Lattice and the colony are at peace.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_LinkQuiet: {PAWN_nameDef}'s link into {FACTION} has gone quiet: they are no longer at peace with the colony, and the bandwidth they lent is gone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_MechanitorGone: The mechanitor is not at home any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_AlreadyLinked: The mechanitor is already linked in, or no longer has a mechlink.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_LinkWork: {0} works on {1} for two hours with the array, where {1} stands
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Bandwidth: {0} can command {1} more bandwidth of mechs while {2} and the colony are at peace
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Dreams: Now and then {0} dreams another linked mind's dream: a small mood for a day, good or bad
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Relinked: {WARDEN} has relinked the {MECH} at the gate, and the Lattice has paid the colony {COUNT} silver for the trouble. The wardens are taking it home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_FeralDown: The feral {MECH} is down. Its wreck is the colony's, to take apart for its parts.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_FeralGone: The feral mech is already down or gone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Relink: {0} calls the {1} over the link; it walks to the gate, where it is relinked and led home
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Down: The link-wardens go after the {0}, and the colony's fighters can join them
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Wreck: The wreck of the {0} is the colony's, for its parts
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Fight: It fights back: whoever goes near it may be hurt (the game's own fight)
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Roams: The {0} roams the colony's land, attacking whatever comes near, until it wanders off
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_YardHireStart: The Lattice's mechs are working for the colony today: the hauling mechs carry its loose things into the stockpiles, and the rest mend its worn buildings.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_YardHireOver: The day's hire is over, and the Lattice's mechs have gone back to their own work.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_YardFeral: A {THING} at the Lattice's mech yard has slipped its link and gone feral. It attacks whatever comes near it. {X_nameDef} and the link-hands are going after it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_YardHired: Their mechs are already working for the colony today.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_YardNoMechs: They have no mechs fit to work.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Yard: A mech-tender, two link-hands and their labour mechs of {0} camp by the colony for five to seven days
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_YardRock: The plain rock their mechs cut is left piled by their camp for the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_YardHire: For a day their hauling mechs carry the colony's loose things into its stockpiles and the rest mend its worn buildings
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_YardTurns: It can turn: a mech may slip its link and go feral, or a band may come against the yard for its mechs
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_HumDeeper: {CANTOR} sat at {PAWN_nameDef}'s bed through the night, and by morning {PAWN_possessive} psylink is at level {LEVEL}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_HumWoke: {CANTOR} sat at {PAWN_nameDef}'s bed through the night, and by morning {PAWN_pronoun} has a first psylink.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_HumChronicle: A cantor of {FACTION} sat with {PAWN_nameDef} through a night, and {PAWN_possessive} psylink went a level deeper.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_HumGone: The colonist is not at home any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_HumChanged: The colonist's psylink has changed since, or they have no bed.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_NoArt: The colony has no piece of art worth enough to give.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_HumNight: {0} sits at {1}'s bed through the night, humming, while {1} lies listening
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Listened: Once the night is over, everyone at home feels the cantor's listening: a calm for most, an unease for about {CHANCE}% of ordinary people, more for the psychically sensitive
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_VoidSat: {WARDEN} stayed beside {PAWN_nameDef} all day, and {PAWN_pronoun} is steadier for it: some of what the void took from {PAWN_objective} has come back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_VoidQuiet: {WARDEN} listened at the edge of the colony's land and says the void is quiet around the colony for now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_VoidWarn: {WARDEN} of {FACTION} listened, and says the void around the colony is drawing toward {KIND}. The Choir's wardens say that what they hear like this comes within the month.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_VoidCame: {WARDEN} of the Choir said the void would send {KIND} next.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_VoidGaveUp: {WARDEN} could not stay any longer, and has gone back to the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ShakenGone: The colonist is not at home any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_VoidSit: {0} stays at {1}'s side through the day, following {1} about
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Sanity: Some of {0}'s sanity returns, and the void's memories on {0} are lifted
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Memories: The void's memories on {0} are lifted
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_VoidEdge: {0} listens an hour at the edge of the colony's land
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Foretold: The warden says what kind of threat the void will send next; the next one of its kind within {0} days is that one
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ShoutCalmed: {LISTENER} sat beside {PAWN_nameDef}, and the break is over: {PAWN_pronoun} is calm again.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ShoutCalmedWith: {LISTENER} and {HELPER} sat beside {PAWN_nameDef}, and the break is over: {PAWN_pronoun} is calm again, and {HELPER} learned something of how the Choir does it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ShoutPassed: {LISTENER} has gone back to the road; {PAWN}'s break was over before they were done.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ShoutNoWay: {LISTENER} could not get to {PAWN} to sit with them, and has gone back to the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_NoHelper: Nobody of the colony is free to sit with them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_ShoutSit: {0} sits beside {1} for two hours, following if {1} wanders
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_ShoutEnds: The break ends there, calmly, and {0} feels better for it
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_ShoutLearn: {0} sits with them and learns how ({1})
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_RingFelt: The Choir sang at their ring this evening, and the colony felt it: {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_RingStrange: The Choir's singing at their ring went wrong tonight, and everyone at home who heard it is uneasy. {X_nameDef} says the void is too close to the colony for them to stay, and they are packing up.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_RingLoud: The Choir's ring can hear {A_nameDef} working nearby tonight, after the colony promised them quiet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_RingSat: {A_nameDef} sat with the Choir at their ring and came back calm, {A_possessive} focus full.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_NoPsycaster: The colony has nobody with a psylink.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Promised: The colony has already promised them quiet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Ring: A few of {0} camp for some days at the colony's quietest place and sing each evening
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_RingFelt: Each night the colony feels their song: a calm for most, an unease for about {CHANCE}% of ordinary people, more for the psychically sensitive
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_RingPromise: The colony keeps mining, building and taking down away from them at night
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_RingVoid: With the void stirring, their song may go strange one night, and then they leave
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_RingSit: {0} sits with them a couple of hours and comes back with a full focus
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_SealTownGone: The vault's town is gone or no longer theirs.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_SealLapsed: Nobody of the colony came to {TOWN}, and {FACTION} held the vault's door as best they could without the colony's fighters.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_SealFightInsects: The colony's caravan has reached {TOWN}. The insects that dug into the vault's lower level have come up onto the ground beside it, and the colony's people are there to meet them, with {COUNT} of {FACTION}'s security beside them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_SealFightMechs: The colony's caravan has reached {TOWN}. The mechs that broke into the vault's lower level have come up onto the ground beside it, and the colony's people are there to meet them, with {COUNT} of {FACTION}'s security beside them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_SealLeft: The colony's people left the fight at {TOWN} before it was won.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_SealWon: Nothing that came up from the vault's lower level at {TOWN} is still standing. {FACTION} has set a share of its stores down by the colony's people: {GOODS}. The vault will remember the colony's help.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_SealGo: Two or more of the colony's grown people go to {0} by caravan within {1} days
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_SealFight: There, the fight against what came up ({0}) on open ground beside the vault, the game's own: the colony's people may be hurt or killed
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_SealStores: Won, a share of the vault's last stores, set down by the colony's people there
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_SealThanks: Won, {0} thinks better of the colony (+{1})
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_PartFailed: {MEDIC}'s surgery on {PAWN_nameDef} didn't take: the vault's last part is lost.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_PartHanded: {MEDIC} has handed the vault's {PART} over at the gate for {PAWN_nameDef}. The surgery is set for the colony's doctor.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_NoDoctor: The colony has no doctor of its own.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_PartRisk: {SURGEON} fits it by the game's own surgery: {CHANCE}% to succeed, {FAIL}% that it fails and the part is lost
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_PartYear: The components and food hold {0}'s age for about a year
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ConsoleRadio_1: {PAWN_nameDef} talked with the overseer of {FACTION} over the radio this evening, mostly about what the colony grows and what the weather does.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ConsoleRadio_2: {PAWN_nameDef} talked with the overseer of {FACTION} again this evening. The overseer talked about the people who went back below the day the seal was broken.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ConsoleRadio_3: {PAWN_nameDef} talked with the overseer of {FACTION} for the last evening, about how many of the vault's machines still work.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ConsoleLetter_1: {PAWN_nameDef} wrote back to the overseer of {FACTION} this evening, mostly about what the colony grows and what the weather does, and the runner took the letter.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ConsoleLetter_2: {PAWN_nameDef} wrote to the overseer of {FACTION} again this evening. The overseer's letter was about the people who went back below the day the seal was broken.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ConsoleLetter_3: {PAWN_nameDef} wrote the last letter to the overseer of {FACTION} this evening, and the runner took it back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_TalkerGone: The colonist is not at home any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_CacheHeard: An old supply cache of {FACTION}, from before the seal was broken.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_CacheRadio: On the last evening the overseer of {FACTION} told {PAWN} where the vault left an old supply cache, back when its people first came up: {COUNT} tiles {WAY} of the colony. The vault has no one to send for it, and the colony may take what is there.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_CacheLetter: In the last letter the overseer of {FACTION} told {PAWN} where the vault left an old supply cache, back when its people first came up: {COUNT} tiles {WAY} of the colony. The vault has no one to send for it, and the colony may take what is there.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_TalkRadio: {0} goes to the colony's radio for an hour at dusk, {1} evening(s), to talk with the overseer
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_TalkLetters: A runner brings the overseer's letter each evening, and {0} writes back at the colony's table, {1} evening(s)
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_TalkEnd: At the end, the overseer of {0} asks the colony for something, or tells where an old supply cache lies
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutTaught: {A_nameDef} taught the vault's scouts about {THING} at their fire for two hours, and {X_nameDef} says they will take it back down with them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutTalkedOut: {A_nameDef} talked with {X_nameDef} for an hour, and {X_nameDef} has come out of the tent.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutSkyPassed: {X_nameDef} has come out of the tent at last, and is looking up at the sky again.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutLost: {X_nameDef}, one of the vault's scouts, went out at dusk to look at the land and has not come back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutFound: {A_nameDef} found {X_nameDef} out on the land and is walking {X_objective} back to the scouts' camp.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutBack: {X_nameDef} found {X_possessive} own way back to the scouts' camp at first light.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutMauled: {X_nameDef}, one of the vault's scouts, walked up to a {THING} to look at it, not knowing it was dangerous, and it has turned on {X_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutOdds: {X_nameDef} has set the scouts' last odds and ends out by their fire for the colony: {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutBusy: Someone of the colony is teaching them already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_ScoutNotSick: None of them is keeping to the tent.
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Scouts: Three surface-scouts of {0} camp by the colony for a week to learn the surface
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_ScoutsLearn: Each afternoon they ask to be taught; what they learn the vault keeps, and it holds its age
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_ScoutsTurns: It can turn: one may be sky-sick, one may get lost at night, one may walk up to a beast that turns on them
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Lesson: {0} goes to the scouts' fire and teaches them two hours about {1}
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_TalkOut: {0} goes to the scouts' camp and talks an hour with the one in the tent
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Search: {0} goes out on the land to where the lost scout is and walks them back
LanguageData.CC_PEv9_Impact_Odds: A few of {0}'s last goods, set down at their fire for the colony
